# Square Image Filter

Computes the square of each pixel.

## Group (Subgroup)

ImageProcessing (Pointwise)

## Description

Computes `x * x` for every pixel. ITK-free, out-of-core-capable reimplementation of the legacy ITK Square Image Filter.
